method: src/pgwr/install-to-card.sh; autodetected card, automatic backup, .new staging, cmp/diff verification
manifest: builds/pgwr/0.20.2/ (no MANIFEST.json; the mod tree is byte-identical to 0.20.0's, only the NRO differs)
mod_tree_note: Unchanged from 0.20.0. The fix is Rust-only (status/monkey_flip.rs, acmd/monkey_flip.rs), so the 0.20.0 tree was reused rather than regenerated; its hash was recomputed and equals the card's pre-install hash, so no asset differs.
change_vs_0.20.0: Monkey Flip diagnostics now reach the card log. All 12 [PGWR-MFLIP] sites used a bare println!, which only reaches the console TCP stream; article::log is the crate's only writer of sd:/ultimate/pgwr_log.txt. A new status::monkey_flip::log mirrors it with the move's prefix. No diagnostic removed, no state-changing call added.
why: Two hardware runs of Monkey Flip, on G&W and on Diddy, produced zero [PGWR-MFLIP] lines in the log despite the move firing, so the victim half of the capture has never been measured.
version_collision_note: Numbered 0.20.2 because a concurrent session had already claimed 0.20.1 in Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and was mid-build of it. One shared plugin binary carries both changes.
